rules.what: Runtime modules may import only domains declared in .harness/scope.json.
rules.why: Hidden back-edges make specialized agents and low-level security code affect orchestration unpredictably.
rules.fix: Move the dependency behind an existing boundary or update scope.json with an explicit reviewed rationale.

rules.what: Runtime Python must not import development-harness state or scripts.
rules.why: The product must run independently of coding-agent session state.
rules.fix: Move runtime behavior into src/ and keep feature/progress/bootstrap logic outside the product.

rules.what: At most one feature may be active unless explicit disjoint ownership is introduced.
rules.why: One active feature prevents scope drift and unverifiable partial work.
rules.fix: Finish or block the current feature before activating another.
